Locked notes are now encrypted on disk.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Locked notes encrypted at rest.** A locked note's file is sealed on disk, not just hidden in the app.

### ✨ Improvements
- Focus mode gets a bottom bar.
- Shared notes sort in with your own.

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- Back up the `.papyra` folder in your data volume — it holds the keys for locked notes. Losing it means losing those notes.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.3.1...v0.3.2](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2)
